values.note: Drinking water at several spots, plus a fill site for potable water just beyond site #16; no water in the off-season. Bear-proof dumpsters.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234618 ('accessible pit toilets and drinking water', 'A fill site for potable water is located just beyond Site #16', 'Bear proof garbage dumpsters', 'Camping is permitted during the off-season but water is not available') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/rombo-campground (Restrooms 'Vault toilet(s)'; Water 'Available at several locations throughout the campground'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: recreation.gov: 'Camping is permitted during the off-season but water is not available.' Fee/reservation season 2026: May 22 - Sept 7. Call 406-821-3269 about road closures.
$15 a single site; $5 a night per additional vehicle. Cash or check at the campground.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/rombo-campground ('Single Site: $15 per night', 'Additional Vehicle: $5 per night', 'Please be prepared to pay with CASH or CHECK') + recreation.gov rates (2026 STANDARD NONELECTRIC $15), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service (West Fork Ranger District) with an on-site host. 7 of 16 sites reservable on recreation.gov (until 3 days before arrival); the rest first-come. 16 consecutive days maximum.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/rombo-campground ('Camping is limited to 16 consecutive days', 'Sites may be reservable') + recreation.gov catalog (7 reservable, 9 not) and rules (maxConsecutiveStay 16, reservationCutOff 3), read 2026-10-22

note: Bitterroot NF (West Fork Ranger District) campground along the West Fork Bitterroot River, ~18 mi SW of Darby on Forest Road 473 toward Painted Rocks State Park (5 mi further). Tall ponderosa shade; shoreline stabilization along the campground was completed fall 2025. No cell coverage. Historic Alta Ranger Station nearby. --Claude
